access_links.label: Transport demand on the openmod wiki

description: Mobilität in Deutschland is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Transport demand > Introduction", published or maintained by mobilitaet-in-deutschland.de (publisher inferred from the link). Transport demand can be measured either by final energy consumption (transport's energy demand) or in terms of km travelled. Final energy consumption is usually measured/estimated by statistical offices on an annual basis for a specified geographical / country scope. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Transport demand" lists it under "Introduction". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport demand inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
licence: not stated on the wiki page (source page not read)
